viewport_notes: article detail: readable measure (~60–80ch), clear H1, body imagery in-flow, a CTA/related at the end.

checks.rule: no spacing collisions/overlap; nothing overflows the viewport; typography cascade intact
no missing-image placeholders, no Liquid errors, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text, no copy typos in rendered text
body text line length is comfortable (~60–80 characters) — not edge-to-edge full-width on desktop
article title is the H1; in-article headings descend h2>h3; meta (date/author) is secondary
in-body images sit in flow without overflow and keep their subject on mobile
the article ends with a path forward (related posts, newsletter, or a product CTA) — not a dead end
